parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is the leg (handle) part of the pliers, made of steel, typically covered with an insulating grip for comfort and safety.
parts.Functional_description: The leg acts as the handle that provides leverage to operate the jaws of the pliers. It is the main part grasped by the user to apply force.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other leg, allowing the jaws to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the pliers, made of steel, forming the central pivot and jaw structure.
parts.Functional_description: The base body connects the two legs and includes the pivot joint and gripping jaws, enabling the pliers to hold, twist, or cut materials.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary except for the pivoting motion at the joint, which allows the jaws to move symmetrically.
